launch_ecs_task: launch an AWS ECS Fargate task on the craftassist cluster and return its task ARN
describe_ecs_task_ip: describe an ECS task by ARN and resolve its public IP address via ENI attachment
run_launch_and_ping: run the main loop to poll a task ARN, get its IP, and ping a Minecraft server port
review_launch_task: review the launch_task function to understand how it configures ECS Fargate networking with subnets and security groups
refactor_describe_task: refactor the describe_task function to handle missing attachments or network interfaces more gracefully
